name: The Color Blue
overview: Scripture reveals the color blue as a significant and sacred hue associated with God's presence and the priestly service. The blue of the tabernacle curtains and the robe of the ephod symbolizes heavenly purity and divine authority, reflecting the glory of God as seen beneath His feet like a sapphire stone (Exodus 24:10; 26:1; 28:31). Additionally, the command to wear blue fringes on garments serves as a tangible reminder to God's people to live in obedience and reverence (Numbers 15:38). Thus, blue in the Bible points believers toward holiness and the majesty of the Creator.
